## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a conventional commit, 72 characters or fewer, such as `fix(button): keep focus ring visible` (the squashed title becomes the commit on `main`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test` and `bun run build` pass
- [ ] Checked in both LTR and RTL, and in light and dark
- [ ] Docs and Storybook updated where needed, in English and Arabic
- [ ] No version bump and no changelog edit (the release bot does both)
